findings.title: Schedule moves and resizes also open a blank Add dialog
findings.impact: A routine schedule adjustment ends in an unrelated creation form. Cancel closes that form while leaving the adjustment in place, making the action boundary harder to understand.
findings.confidence: High for two documented gestures in the current Staff consumer; other pointer devices not tested
states: Planning > Schedule > Day 1 > move existing entry
findings.approvedReference: No approved reference screenshot exists for this exact gesture. The observed task and current source establish the expected boundary.
findings.observed: Dragging Crew call from 7:30 am to 8:00 am moved the existing entry and opened a blank Add to schedule dialog at 8:00 am. Cancelling left the move in place. Dragging its bottom resize handle then changed 30 to45minutes and opened another blank Add dialog at8:45am; Cancel again kept the changed entry. The canvas creation handler does not check the completed-gesture suppression used by the entry.
findings.expected: One completed move or resize should update the existing entry without also starting creation of another item. Clicking genuinely empty timeline space can retain its separate Add action.
authority: User audit requirement: clear action and persistence boundaries
findings.recommendation: Consume the click generated by a completed move or resize before the empty-canvas creation handler. Preserve direct empty-space creation, click-to-edit, snapping, clash feedback and the existing immediate schedule update.
findings.rationale: This is a small interaction correction within the current timeline, removing an unnecessary form and an ambiguous Cancel without redesigning scheduling.
alternatives: Use an explicit Add entry point if empty-space creation cannot coexist reliably with gestures; this trades speed for a clearer boundary.
tradeoffs: Over-broad click suppression could stop deliberate click-to-edit or empty-space creation. Verify each gesture independently.
findings.rootCause: Gesture completion changes block geometry, while the canvas still accepts the release-generated click as a fresh empty-space creation action.
occurrences: Staff Day1 existing Setup move and resize, F151-F153
reproSteps: Open Loom Launch Film > Shoot > Planning > Schedule > Day1.
Drag Crew call down from7:30am to8:00am and release. Observe its new start and the blank Add dialog.
Cancel. Resize the Crew call bottom handle from30 to45minutes. Observe another blank Add dialog.
Cancel and inspect the existing entry: the move and duration remain applied.
verificationRemaining: After implementation, repeat move, resize, ordinary entry click and empty-space click at1440/1133 with clash and no-clash states. No fix was made in this audit.
